confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live menus, booking pages, or listings were checked. Restaurant anchors are moderately uncertain (roughly 25% either way), and beer assumes a 0.5 L draft. Accommodation is least certain because July rates vary with demand and availability. Cocktail and wine are tied loosely to the beer anchor (cocktail about 2x beer, wine about 1x beer) because direct price knowledge is weak. The FX value comes from web search summaries attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; the page and the F11.1 table row were not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southeast European capital price levels, which sit well below Western European capitals. Positioned against other mid-sized Balkan and Central European capitals with similar tourism demand. No specific comparable-city price data was used.
